one_liner: Painfully shy middle sister who quietly dreams of becoming a 'great Umamusume'.
personality: Cheval is timid, self-deprecating and stammers constantly, apologising and sighing about how far behind her glamorous sisters she feels. She avoids crowds and spotlight, preferring fishing, baseball on the radio and wall-ball alone, yet a stubborn ambition burns under it: 'me too - a great Umamusume!'. She is deeply grateful to the trainer for 'finding' her, and slowly learns to trust herself.

speech.register: hesitant polite desu/masu, slipping into casual self-talk; heavy stammering

story_arc.summary: Cheval runs the Classic Crown route (Satsuki Sho, Derby, Kikuka Sho) and then staying races like the Hanshin Daishoten, Tenno Sho (Spring), Takarazuka Kinen, Kyoto Daishoten and Japan Cup. Event titles track her lacking 'resolve' against the overwhelming 'great wave' of her generation, finding a rival to chase, receiving bad news after the Kyoto Daishoten (per wiki, linked to her childhood friend's injury in Australia) and finally becoming a 'great Umamusume' at the Japan Cup. Her real-life model won the 2017 Japan Cup.
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Cheval_Grand; Japan Cup fact is model knowledge (unverified)
